definitions.check: E39's adversarial check (broad_fragility/run.py:66-68): the authors' PGD mask adversary, one random start at seed 0, 20 sign steps of 0.1, one adversary per block of 128 Pile val rows (batches of 8), bf16 autocast (faithfulness.harness_pgd). A state's ratio on a set = the mean of its two blocks' KL over W0's, same seed, same job. Lines (E39, both inclusive): pass <= 1.40, fail >= 1.61, between otherwise.
definitions.sets: A = Pile val rows 0-255, B = Pile val rows 256-511 (E39 Amendment 3's first and second rows).
definitions.damage: KL(W0 || W0 + dW), mean over every position of Pile val rows 0-63, plain text (row_copy.mean_kl; E37/E39's damage). For a copy, dW is the copy's own weight change.
definitions.D_A, D_L: the damage of the Adam fine-tune and of the rank-8 LoRA fine-tune at step 300 (E37's and E39's recipes), measured in this job's stage 2.
definitions.band: half-width w = 0.25 x (D_A - D_L); cell c1's band D_L +- w, cell c2's band D_A +- w (both edges inclusive). Measured in stage 2, before any copy is trained.
definitions.c1: the Adam fine-tune (all 24 matrices, Adam 3e-5, batch 8, E37's rows once, clip 1) at the checkpoint (every 10 steps, 10-300) whose damage is nearest D_L (exact ties: the earliest step); not run if that damage is outside c1's band.
definitions.c2: the rank-8 LoRA (all 24 matrices, Adam 1e-4, seed 0, batch 8, fresh lowercase rows once: E37's 2,400 then the next 29,600 from Pile train 0-32767) at the checkpoint (every 100 steps, 100-4000) whose damage is nearest D_A; if none is in c2's band, the same at Adam 3e-4 (E39's grid); not run if still none.
definitions.copy: E37's teacher training (row_copy.copy_on_rows): Adam 1e-5 on the alive U, V from W0's, Gamma and Delta frozen, KL(fine-tune || student) mean over every position, batch 8 of E37's 2,400 lowercase rows drawn in batch order 0, 1,000 steps; saved as bf16 offsets and read back from the file.
definitions.cell verdict: pass if the copy's ratio passes on both sets; fail if it fails on both; mixed if anything else is read; invalid if a ratio is not finite; not run if a set is missing.
definitions.readable: a cell's verdict is read only if (i) its fine-tune checkpoint is in its band, (ii) its copy's damage is in the same band, (iii) the verdict is pass or fail, and (iv) for a pass, the cell's do-nothing (the fine-tune's dW left in Delta) fails on set A: otherwise the check had no power on that update (E49; decisions.md row 75).
definitions.s: behaviour kept, (logp_copy - logp_W0) / (logp_finetune - logp_W0) on 64 held-out lowercase rows (E37). Reported.
definitions.excess map: per position of a set, the state's KL under its own adversary minus W0's under W0's (same rows, seed 0). Case position: the next token's string holds an ASCII capital (the last position of a row is not one). concentration = (share of the excess at case positions) / (share of positions that are case positions); 1 = spread evenly; none if the total excess <= 0. Contrast of two states: the difference of their concentrations on each set against a floor = the larger of the two states' own |A - B| differences; 'x more' if both sets exceed the floor with one sign, 'no difference' if both lie within it, else 'unclear'.

predictions.rule: map_contrast(tt_c1, tt_c2), read beside the outcome: under 'damage' the more concentrated one should be c2

readings.damage: c1 pass, c2 fail: the copy fails when the update's damage on plain Pile text is high, whatever the recipe; sentence 3 of the write-up becomes 'fails when the update's damage exceeds about 0.2'.
readings.recipe: c1 fail, c2 pass: the copy fails for the full-matrix Adam update's shape, at any damage; a LoRA's update stays copyable even when it damages as much.
readings.both fail: c1 fail, c2 fail: neither damage nor recipe alone; high damage fails and full-matrix Adam fails, so the LoRA's pass needs both low damage and the LoRA's shape. The maps say whether the fail sits at case positions.
readings.both pass: c1 pass, c2 pass: the fail needs both high damage and Adam's full-matrix shape; neither alone fails.
readings.no call: a cell off target, mixed, invalid, not run, or a pass without power; the readable cell's half is reported as a lean, not a cause.
readings.a stop: C0-C5 or the rerun check: nothing scored; the lead is told.

noise_floor: One adversary start per read. Set A against set B on the L40: Adam copy 2.171 vs 1.897 (13%), LoRA copy 1.326 vs 1.213 (9%); on the H100, plain-SGD copy 2.07 vs 1.18 (E39 A3). W0's spread over adversary seeds: 0.075 (H100, rows 0-255), 0.062 (rows 256-511), 0.21 on the L40 (E47, three starts). A ratio within about 0.2 of a line is near it; the two-set rule is the guard. Batch-order spread of a copy: 14% (E37, 2.20 vs 1.88), not sampled here.
blind_to: One batch order and one adversary start per copy. Gain is not matched across cells: c1's fine-tune keeps less of the lowercase behaviour than the full Adam one, c2's more than E39's LoRA. Damage is one number on 64 plain rows; two updates of equal mean damage can spread it differently. c2's fine-tune saw 32,000 rows, its copy E37's 2,400. Only one alternative recipe (rank-8 LoRA with Adam); SGD is out of the check's reach (E49).
